title: Sloth wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- body / fur -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="30" ry="24" fill="#8B6B4A"/>
  <!-- lighter inner fur on belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="18" ry="15" fill="#C9A97C"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="22" fill="#A07E58"/>
  <!-- face mask (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#E4CBA8"/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="41" rx="6" ry="5.5" fill="#5E4530"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="41" rx="6" ry="5.5" fill="#5E4530"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="41" r="3" fill="#2E2016"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="41" r="3" fill="#2E2016"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFF6E0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFF6E0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#4A3322"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 54 Q50 58 56 54" stroke="#7A5A3A" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ear tufts / fur sides -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="44" r="5" fill="#8B6B4A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="44" r="5" fill="#8B6B4A"/>
  <!-- arms reaching up (sloth hanging vibe) -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="62" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#8B6B4A" transform="rotate(15 24 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="62" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#8B6B4A" transform="rotate(-15 76 62)"/>
  <!-- claws -->
  <rect x="20" y="50" width="3" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#E4CBA8"/>
  <rect x="26" y="50" width="3" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#E4CBA8"/>
  <rect x="71" y="50" width="3" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#E4CBA8"/>
  <rect x="77" y="50" width="3" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#E4CBA8"/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d="M50 2 L62 30 L38 30 Z" fill="#E8408A"/>
  <path d="M50 2 L56 16 L44 16 Z" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="3" r="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d="M41 26 L59 26" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 19 L56 19" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- pom dots -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="31" r="2" fill="#FFD23F"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="31" r="2" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="31" r="2" fill="#FFD23F"/>
</svg>
